nhshealthierfamilies_1.author: NHS Better Health
nhshealthierfamilies_1.title: Chilli con carne
ingredients: 2 handfuls of cup or button mushrooms, sliced
nhshealthierfamilies_1.description: This classic chilli is packed with flavour. It also freezes well, so is perfect to batch-cook.

nhshealthierfamilies_2.author: NHS Better Health
nhshealthierfamilies_2.title: Good old fish and chips
ingredients: 4 potatoes, scrubbed, each cut into 8 wedges
1 egg, beaten with 2 tbsp cold water
4 fillets skinless white fish, like haddock, cod or pollock
nhshealthierfamilies_2.description: Make your own healthier version of fish and chips at home!

panelinha_2.author: Panelinha
panelinha_2.title: Arroz sírio com frango
ingredients: 2 bifes de filé de peito de frango (cerca de 240 g)
¼ de xícara (chá) de nozes picadas
⅓ de xícara (chá) de iogurte natural
panelinha_2.description: Nesta versão com frango, o tradicional e perfumado arroz com lentilhas libanês se transforma numa refeição completa. E o melhor, feito numa panela só!

usdamyplate_2.author: MyPlate
usdamyplate_2.title: Asparagus, Mandarin Orange, Chicken, and Rice
ingredients: 3 tablespoons mandarin orange juice (reserved from oranges)
2 cans 11 oz cans mandarin oranges (drained, reserve juice)
12 ounces cooked chicken breast (cut into chunks)
usdamyplate_2.description: Fresh California asparagus, mandarin oranges, chicken, and brown rice make perfect compliments in this Asian-influenced salad.
